mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment(board_id, member_id, parent_comment_id, content) VALUES(#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{parentCommentId}, #{content})
mapper.sql: c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, COALESCE(lc.like_count, 0) AS like_count, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, m.nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.profile, ''), '/images/common_member.png') AS profile, pm.nickname AS parent_nickname

LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN board_comment p ON c.parent_comment_id = p.comment_id LEFT JOIN member pm ON p.member_id = pm.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT comment_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM comment_like GROUP BY comment_id ) lc ON lc.comment_id = c.comment_id
